Name: Chat vs Streamer
Author: NeighborhoodofMusic
Description: Twitch viewers earn chaos points just by watching and spend them to sabotage the streamer in real time. Spawn monsters, ruin crops, ban inventory access, rename animals, trigger the Chaos Gods, or drop the 50,000pt Nuclear Chaos on the whole farm. Experimental YouTube Live support (beta, via Streamer.bot) and alpha co-op multiplayer targeting included.
